subject.title: feat(plugins): add Control UI entry points

question: Should OpenClaw add registerControlUiEntryPoint as a separate plugin UI API, or fold launch-token behavior into the existing Control UI tab descriptor seam with iframe-only rendering?
rationale: This is a durable plugin SDK, Gateway protocol, and browser security contract; automation can identify unsafe paths, but maintainers need to choose the public API and trust model before third-party plugins depend on it.

options.title: Fold into tab descriptors
options.body: Use the existing descriptor surface as the public contract and add only the missing launch/session-token behavior with iframe-only opaque rendering.

options.title: Approve a separate API after hardening
options.body: Keep registerControlUiEntryPoint but require explicit docs, compatibility rationale, sandbox hardening, fail-closed launch behavior, and exact-head proof before merge.

options.title: Pause for RFC consolidation
options.body: Keep the canonical issue/RFC open while the UI contribution model is narrowed before another implementation attempt.

recommendation.title: Fold into tab descriptors
recommendation.body: Use the existing descriptor surface as the public contract and add only the missing launch/session-token behavior with iframe-only opaque rendering.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the merged generic host-hook foundation that this plugin UI entry-point contract extends.
